milestone: Reliable drag release and elastic trackpad zoom
emscripten: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.9 (4e4223852a0835923411059a3929907d7df1232e)
changes: Capture canvas drags through releases outside the game area. Forward missed outside mouseup events and clear held buttons on lost capture, pointer cancellation, blur, hidden page, or stale zero-button movement.
Preserve fractional browser wheel deltas, normalize line/page units, and consume Chrome Ctrl+wheel pinch without browser-page zoom or duplicate GLFW input.
Shared C logarithmic zoom with smooth response and bounded rubber-band pressure at scale 16/280; reverse input responds immediately and focus/reset presets clear pending zoom.

checks: Reproduced the previous release bug: left-drag from canvas to sidebar, release, then return via middle click caused a large unintended pan.
Repeated the same sequence with the fix: map placement remained unchanged when the pointer returned to the canvas.
Repeated wheel zoom reached close and far limits without flipping or resetting; one reverse wheel action visibly moved away from the close limit.
Far-limit screenshots showed bounded stretch followed by return to the same framing at the limit.

validation_scope: Focused native ASan/UBSan and WASM camera tests plus JavaScript input-event tests. Browser review used real canvas drag and wheel input in Chrome. Pixel/line/page and Ctrl+wheel conversion were exercised in the event tests; a physical Mac trackpad pinch was not automated. Clean native/web builds, artifact and JavaScript checks, and one packaged native/WASM world parity check passed. Generation, unit motion and sensor algorithms are unchanged; their full suites were not repeated.
